svg.title: 작은 혼합 차이와 활성 집단
svg.desc: Educational independent two-site pairing: R:S=75:25; RR=56.25%, RS+SR=37.5%, SS=6.25%. With inactive heterochiral pairs and equally active homochiral pairs, the active fraction is62.5%; its RR:SS composition is90:10 and ee80%. The curve is active-pool ee, E(e)=2e/(1+e^2).
svg.metadata: {"kind": "review educational pairing model", "assumptions": ["independent random pairing", "heterochiral pairs inactive", "homochiral pairs equally active"], "fractions": {"RR": 0.5625, "RS_plus_SR": 0.375, "SS": 0.0625, "active": 0.625}, "active_pool": {"RR": 0.9, "SS": 0.1, "ee": 0.8}, "equation": "E(e)=2e/(1+e^2)", "background_reference": "https://doi.org/10.1021/ja00269a036", "derivation": "independent algebra under the specified educational assumptions"}
svg.text: 무작위 조합 · 이형 비활성 · 동형 동일 활성 · 활성 집단 조성의 교육 계산
